LAREDO — A 46-year-old man was booked into the Webb County Jail early Sunday morning on an alleged felony theft charge, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Fernando Octavio Vargas was booked on October 25, 2026, at 1:55 a.m. The booking record lists theft of property valued at $30,000 to under $150,000, a third-degree felony. Bond was set at $20,000. The record shows him held on an out-of-county hold.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
